name: Tuiren
description: Star of 5,620 K, 294 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: HAT-P-36 b crosses Tuiren as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019.

quotes.title: HAT-P-36
quotes.card: HAT-P-36, also referred to as Tuiren is a 12th magnitude G-type main-sequence star estimated to be approximately 958 light-years away from Earth in the constellation Canes Venatici.
quotes.introduction: HAT-P-36 is too faint to be seen with the naked eye, but it is possible to view it with binoculars or a small telescope.
